taglineEn: Showing your client exactly what you mean.
introZh: 光翊設計工作室專注於 3D 模擬圖、電腦動畫與美術設計製作。從建築、土木工程、室內、景觀到 3C 產品開發,我們把還停留在圖面與模型階段的設計,轉譯成客戶一眼就看懂的畫面。累積二十年 3ds Max 與 SketchUp 實務經驗,熟悉工程端的圖說與作業流程,溝通不必從頭解釋;交件準時、修改回應快,是設計團隊與業主之間最直接的溝通介面。
introEn: STUDIO HIKARI produces 3D visualization, animation, and design imagery for architecture, civil engineering, interiors, landscape, and product development. We turn drawings and models into images a client can read at a glance. Two decades of production experience in 3ds Max and SketchUp — and a working knowledge of engineering drawings and delivery schedules — means we speak your team's language from the first briefing. Delivered on time, revised fast.
